subject: Real rootfs resource families now inventoried
body: Corpus agent produced gpu/build/ui-corpus-20261025/resource-aggregate.json and per-AIR resources.jsonl. Static unspecialized declarations include sampled/writable/read-write float/half/int/uint/short/ushort 2D and arrays; 1D,3D,cube,cube-array,depth2D/depthCube/depth2Darray,multisample plus descriptor arrays/array_ref. Real intrinsics include sample/gather/read/write, explicit gradients, size/mip/sample queries, texture fences, null texture queries, and imageblock-to-texture writes. Counts are unspecialized declarations, not runtime occurrence/qualification. Use this matrix to publish handled versus remaining cases; do not limit the claimed scope to ordinary sampler2D. Ask corpus owner for exact private fixtures.
